entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I need to make a return. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly help you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's the new Aero Pro jersey I ordered. I saved up for it and was so excited, but it's the wrong size. It's just... it's way too tight across the chest. I feel silly even wearing it.
I understand completely, getting the right fit is crucial. So it's not a defect with the material, just a sizing preference?

Yes, I guess so. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and this has never happened. I just really needed this for an event this weekend, and now I can't go. I really needed the prize money from that race, too.

I see. Let's not give up on your event just yet. I see you received the jersey just two days ago, so you are unfortunately outside our 10-day policy. We can absolutely get you an exchange for the correct size.
You can? Oh, that would be a relief. But... would it even get here in time? The event is this Saturday.

That's a great question. And let me just say, I see here on your account that you're a VIP member. We truly appreciate your loyalty. To make this right and to make sure you're ready for your race, I'm going to process the exchange for you right now and I'll personally upgrade your shipping to complimentary overnight, on us.
Wait, really? You can do that? Oh my gosh, Isaac, that's amazing! You've completely saved my weekend. Thank you, thank you!

It's my pleasure. Happy we could sort it out. So, I have the new size ready to go. I'm also emailing you a pre-paid return label for the jersey that was too tight. You can just drop that in the mail at your convenience. Can I help with anything else?
No, that's everything. You've been a wonderful help. I really appreciate it.
You are very welcome. Thanks again for calling VeloFit, and best of luck in your race on Saturday!
